integration_issues.flow: Podcast episode — chapter markers on scrubber
integration_issues.issue: mobile-scrubber-marker-* markers never render for the seeded audio-only episode ep_ui_demo because the map is gated on `dur > 0` AND the media response returns `duration_seconds: 0`. Parent passes `dur || media?.duration_seconds || 0` which stays 0 for audio pre-playback. Fix options: (a) code — in ChapterScrubber (line ~290) infer a fallback duration = max(chapters[].start_seconds) + margin when dur=0 so tick markers still render at correct proportional positions; (b) data — persist duration_seconds on ep_ui_demo (and generally compute it on upload / ingest). Currently the spec testID mobile-scrubber-marker-0 is unreachable for audio episodes without playback + a live duration.

critical_code_review_comments: mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx:280,290 — ChapterScrubber gates marker rendering on `dur > 0`. When both the live player duration and media.duration_seconds are 0, the scrubber shows but no markers ever appear. See action item HIGH above.

backend/routes/gift_cards.py:143 — `origin_url` is required for card purchase but the mobile client passes `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` which is the API host, not a user-facing site. success_url therefore points at the backend URL, not a real web/mobile completion screen. Consider requiring a dedicated frontend url or picking BIGFM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL server-side (already fallback) so mobile can pass null.

backend/routes/gift_cards.py:127 — idempotency_key is `giftcard:points:{uid}:{uuid4[:8]}` which is randomized every call — the `_issue_card` idempotency guard is effectively a no-op. A retry from a flaky network will double-charge points. Consider requiring a client-supplied Idempotency-Key header (or hash of product_id+amount+ts).

backend/routes/gift_cards.py:69 — resolving `gifted_to_email` to an existing user via lowercased email means the buyer's own email typo becomes their own card (silent). Consider explicit verification/notification instead of best-effort lookup.
mobile/app/giftcards.tsx:85 — `origin_url: process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` — see backend note above; this URL is not a user-facing surface.

mobile/app/bookings.tsx:47 — after successful booking, the local `booked[]` map is keyed by campaign_id, but the venue list is not re-fetched, so if the campaign fills up on server-side (bookings === cap) it will still show 'Book now' in the UI. Consider awaiting `load()` on success.

rca of the issue: mobile-scrubber-marker-* missing on /podcast/episode/ep_ui_demo — RCA: /app/mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx ChapterScrubber (lines 280 + 290) guards marker rendering on `dur > 0`. `dur` is passed as `dur || media?.duration_seconds || 0`. GET /api/podcasts/episodes/ep_ui_demo/media returns `duration_seconds: 0` (confirmed via curl this run), and audio has not started playback, so both fall back to 0 → the `chapters.map(...)` loop is short-circuited and no marker testIDs appear in the DOM even though 2 chapters (Intro @0s, Main @60s) exist. Two clean fixes are listed under action_items.
